note: The Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem was derived from the mathematical foundations of information theory — specifically from Shannon's work on channel capacity and signal representation. The theorem came into existence as a consequence of information-theoretic analysis, making information theory the source from which it was derived.

Phase vocoder is a time-frequency analysis/synthesis technique built for the sake of speech and audio manipulation — pitch shifting, time stretching, and phase-coherent reconstruction that improve perceived quality and intelligibility. Its designed purpose is to serve speech enhancement workflows that require phase-aware processing. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Pinned sense: estoppel is a specific body of enforceable legal rules — a doctrine barring a party from asserting a fact or right contradicting their prior position, enforced by courts and sustained through precedent (per the entry's accepted definition). Against the target's accepted definition — 'explicit, enforceable rules that bind conduct within a recognized jurisdiction, persisting through courts' — estoppel is a cluster of exactly such rules: explicit elements (representation, reliance, detriment), enforceable (courts apply it), conduct-binding (bars the contradicted claim). Nearest existing kind: no 'doctrine' entry exists, so 'law' is the nearest rung (Law 11e). Distinct from the already-accepted estoppel DEPENDS_ON law (operational reliance on the enforcement system) — kind-membership is a separate relation.
Spectral subtraction is a noise reduction technique designed for the purpose of improving speech intelligibility and quality, i.e., serving speech enhancement.

Speech intelligibility is measured through acoustic analysis using signal processing techniques — spectral analysis, SNR computation, and weighting algorithms. Remove signal processing and there is no mechanism to compute or measure speech intelligibility. Constitutive dependency.

Mask-based enhancement operates on time-frequency representations to estimate masks and apply them to magnitude spectra. Remove STFT and the mask estimation and application cannot operate — the technique stops functioning. Operational dependency per Law 8b, not merely sayable. Remove-Y-now-X-stops-operating test satisfied.

STFT is the core analysis tool that speech enhancement algorithms depend on — spectral subtraction, Wiener filtering, and mask-based enhancement all operate on STFT-derived time-frequency representations. Remove STFT and these speech enhancement methods stop functioning. Operational dependency per Law 8b.
Jurisdiction is a specific legal concept defining the scope of authority within the law. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

Formant vocoder is built for the sake of the vocoder — it implements the vocoder's purpose (speech analysis and synthesis) using the specific mechanism of formant frequency modeling. The formant vocoder serves the broader class of vocoders by providing a particular approach to voice transformation.

Estoppel is a specific equitable doctrine that prevents a party from asserting a claim or right that contradicts their prior statements, conduct, or established judgments. It files against equity as the nearest kind — estoppel is one of the specific doctrines within the equitable body of law, not law generally (which would be a leap). Sense pinned: estoppel as the preventing doctrine in common law, not the colloquial sense of forbidding.

Phase coherence is a specific signal-processing property used to quantify consistency of phase relationships in audio signals. It is a kind of signal-processing metric, specific→general. Law 9 satisfied.
A typology is a specific cognitive framework for classifying and organizing concepts. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9). Typologies are made by cognition for cognition.
A quorum is a specific procedural rule within law and governance for establishing minimum participation. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

Dialectic operates through structured argumentation — premises, inferences, and conclusions. Remove logic (the study and principles of valid reasoning) and dialectic loses its framework for distinguishing valid from invalid arguments. The method's core operations of premise evaluation and inference checking require logic to function.

Pinned sense: the standard all-pass section is a specific kind of IIR filter. Its discrete-time form H(z) = (a + z^-1)/(1 + a z^-1) places a pole inside the unit circle with its zero at the reciprocal radius outside — precisely the feedback structure that gives IIR filters their infinite-duration impulse response; a nontrivial exact all-pass (unity magnitude for all frequency) cannot be realized as an FIR, only pure delays. A competent DSP speaker calls an all-pass section an IIR filter. Nearest kind on the board is iir-filter; 'filter' would leap two rungs up the ladder (Law 11e). Direction: specific all-pass -> general iir-filter, per Law 9.
Butterworth filter design is built for the sake of speech enhancement pipelines that need maximally-flat magnitude response for noise shaping and equalization. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

CONTAINS = part-of, pinned to the target's own accepted definition: information retrieval 'comprises: (1) a document corpus, (2) an index...' — the search index is a constitutive component of the IR system, not merely related to it. Pinned sense: the computational/search-index sense of 'index' (its accepted definition traces marginal notation to algorithmic retrieval), the sense in which the index is a part of IR — not the book-index sense standing alone. Direction: whole (IR) contains part (index).

phase-retrieval IS a DSP technique that reconstructs phase from magnitude spectrograms -- its entire methodology is built on signal-processing fundamentals (STFT, spectral analysis, frequency-domain operations). Remove signal-processing and phase retrieval stops operating.

Mask-based enhancement (spectral masking for speech separation) operates by processing the signal's spectral representation — remove signal-processing as a discipline and mask-based enhancement has no framework, algorithms, or mathematical basis to operate within.
Phase retrieval algorithms operate on magnitude spectrograms produced by STFT; without STFT analysis there is no input representation for retrieval.

Gossip is a social mechanism built for the sake of information spread — its designed purpose is to circulate information (news, judgments, observations) through informal channels. It serves the operation of information flow. Servant→master.

STFT IS the core signal-processing operation that decomposes a signal into time-frequency components. It is a constitutive DSP technique -- the mechanism by which phase-retrieval and spectral-subtraction operate.

Speech processing (analysis, synthesis, enhancement) is built and maintained for the sake of improving how well speech can be understood — speech intelligibility is its designed purpose. Servant (speech-processing) points at master (speech-intelligibility) per Law 8d.

Retroduction (inference to the best explanation) requires logic to evaluate competing hypotheses and determine which explanation best accounts for the evidence. Remove logic and retroduction loses its criteria for valid inference — the process of weighing explanatory power, consistency, and predictive adequacy all depend on logical evaluation.
An arraignment is a specific legal procedure within the law system. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

User feedback requires communication to operate — it is expressed through language, surveys, interviews, or other communicative channels. Remove communication and user feedback cannot be expressed, collected, or transmitted. The mechanism of user feedback IS communication.
MCD computation requires MFCC vectors as input; remove MFCC computation and MCD cannot operate — removal test satisfied, Law 8. Dependency is object-level, not meta-level.
Mask-based enhancement is a specific class of speech enhancement algorithms that use time-frequency masks. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.

Phase retrieval reconstructs phase from magnitude spectrograms to restore perceptual quality of speech signals. It is built for the purpose of serving speech enhancement, servant points at master per Law 8d.

Phase coherence quantifies consistency of phase relationships across frequency components or over time. Measuring consistency requires a phase response as input; without phase response data, coherence cannot be computed or assessed. Removal of phase response stops phase coherence operation.

Jurisdiction is a legal construct that requires language to define its boundaries, express its rules, and enforce its scope. Remove language and jurisdiction cannot operate — legal boundaries become unexpressed, jurisdictional authority cannot be articulated. This is object-level: jurisdiction's mechanism IS linguistic articulation of authority domains, not merely needing language to be discussed.
Speech enhancement is a specific signal-processing discipline for improving speech quality. Specific→general.
Phase vocoder is a specific implementation family within the broader vocoder technique class, using phase information for time-scale modification.

Pinned sense: equity is a SPECIFIC BODY of enforceable legal principles and remedies — the equitable half of the common-law order (maxims of conscience; remedies unavailable at law: injunctions, specific performance, trusts). Against the target's accepted definition — 'a framework of explicit, enforceable rules that bind conduct within a recognized jurisdiction, persisting through institutions (courts)' — equity's maxims are established rules that bind conduct, enforced by courts of chancery within the jurisdiction. A body of law is an instance of law: content of the legal order, not a mechanism serving it. Law 11d: judged against the target's accepted definition. This is the corrected relation for the mis-pinned SERVES edge.

Phase coherence is a measurable property developed to assess and improve the perceptual quality and intelligibility of speech signals, i.e., built for the purpose of serving speech enhancement. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

An all-pass filter is a signal-processing filter built for the sake of phase coherence correction — its designed purpose is to reshape phase relationships across the spectrum while preserving magnitude, serving phase coherence management in audio and DSP chains. Servant→master per Law 8d.

Cepstral subtraction is a noise-suppression technique built specifically for the sake of improving speech intelligibility and quality; it estimates and removes the noise cepstrum to enhance speech. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Cepstral-analysis methodology was developed after the cepstral domain concept (log-magnitude spectrum) was established by Oppenheim and Schafer. The cepstral domain (epoch 0.14) predates cepstral-analysis (epoch 0.77) and fed into it.

Group delay is a specific signal-processing concept that measures the time delay of the envelope of a signal's spectral components as a function of frequency, defined as τg(ω) = −dφ(ω)/dω where φ is phase response. It is an instance of signal-processing — the discipline of algorithms and methods for analyzing and transforming signals. Sense pinned: group delay as the derivative-of-phase concept, not the colloquial sense of a delayed group acting.

Group delay is computed as the negative derivative of phase response with respect to frequency; remove phase response and group delay cannot be calculated or used operationally. Dependency is present-tense operational, not historical.

Estoppel is built for the sake of the legal system — it serves law by preventing injustice and maintaining fairness in legal proceedings. The equitable doctrine exists as a servant of the broader legal framework, not as an end in itself.

The sampling practice preceded the theorem: Nyquist's 1928 condition on pulse rate arose inside telephony sampling practice, and Shannon's 1949 formulation generalized it. The theorem formalizes and bounds the pre-existing practice — it 'fixes the minimum rate for lossless reconstruction' of the sampled signal. Law 7: Y (the practice) existed first and fed into X (the theorem that systematized it).

Speech enhancement is a sub-discipline built entirely from signal processing techniques — spectral subtraction, Wiener filtering, DFT-based processing, and other DSP algorithms are its operational mechanism. Remove signal processing and speech enhancement stops operating: there is no alternative methodology. DEPENDS_ON satisfies the removal test (Laws 2b/8b).

The sampling theorem (Nyquist-Shannon) is a specific mathematical theorem about reconstructing continuous functions from discrete samples. A competent speaker would call the sampling theorem a theorem.

Input validation — checking that input data conforms to expected format, range, type, or constraints before processing — is a specific kind of validation. A competent speaker would call input validation 'a type of validation.'

Cherry-picking — selectively citing evidence that supports a claim while ignoring contradicting evidence — is a specific manifestation of cognitive bias (confirmation bias variant). A competent speaker would call cherry-picking 'a type of cognitive bias.'

The cepstrum was invented by Bogert, Healy and Tukey specifically to detect periodic structures in spectra such as formant spacing. The concept of formants existed first and the cepstrum was developed as a technique for formant analysis.

Mel-cepstral-distortion quantifies perceptual difference between utterances through mel-cepstral coefficient computation — a signal-processing technique. Remove signal-processing (the mathematical analysis and transformation of audio signals) and mel-cepstral-distortion cannot be computed or used. The metric depends on signal-processing for its core computational mechanism.

Canon is a specific type of law — a body of rules, principles, or standards established by an authoritative body (ecclesiastical council, legislative body, or professional organization) and recognized as binding. It files against law as the nearest kind. Note: a DERIVED_FROM edge already exists between canon and law, but INSTANCE_OF expresses a different relationship — canon is a kind/instance of the broader category of law, not merely derived from it.

decimation IS a DSP technique that reduces sample rate by an integer factor M. Its mechanism (anti-aliasing filtering + downsampling) requires signal-processing fundamentals. Remove signal-processing and decimation has no framework.

Pitch-synchronous is a specific type of vocoder technique that operates on a per-frame or per-syllable basis rather than on a continuous frame-by-frame analysis approach. It IS a kind of vocoder. Direction: specific→general. Law 9 satisfied.

Pinned sense: quorum as a VALIDITY threshold — a defined crossing point between two states of a deliberative body's proceedings (voidable/no-binding-action vs valid/binding). Maps onto threshold's accepted parameters: the two sides it separates (validity states), the mark of the boundary (a count — fixed number or fraction), and the conditions for crossing (the required members present). Specific→general (Law 9); threshold is the NEAREST kind on the board (Law 11e) — quorum is a boundary value, not an institution (court), not a practice (governance), not an instruction (rule), and not a member of the law framework.

Canonical forms, references, and standards are built for the purpose of serving truth — they aim to establish the authoritative or most accurate representation. The canonical is designed to approximate truth in a domain. Servant→master per Law 8d.

Syllogism operates as a deductive reasoning form that requires logic to validate its structure — premises, inferences, and conclusions depend on logical criteria to distinguish valid from invalid forms. Remove logic (the study and principles of valid reasoning) and syllogism loses its framework for determining whether a deduction is valid. This is a genuine operational dependency: the practice of syllogistic reasoning requires logical criteria to function.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): the classic Butterworth design as realized recursively — the maximally-flat prototype |H(jw)|=1/sqrt(1+(w/wc)^(2N)) carried to the digital domain by bilinear transform, with poles inside the unit circle and feedback in the difference equation. That realization is a specific member of the recursive filter class: a competent speaker calls a Butterworth IIR section an IIR filter. Nearest kind (Law 11e): iir-filter — no nearer recursive-kind rung exists in the web. FIR approximations of the Butterworth magnitude are a secondary sense, not the pinned one.

A canon is a bounded collection of texts whose selection principle is authority/orthodoxy — exactly the corpus parameter that determines membership. The canon of literature, scripture, and music is a corpus of works filtered by canonical status; a competent speaker calls the canon a corpus. Law 9: X is a specific kind of Y, and corpus is the NEAREST kind (no narrower 'authoritative text collection' exists). Sense pinned to the primary works/texts reading; 'canon of principles' is the secondary sense.

Phase coherence measurement requires the concept of audio phase as its input representation; remove audio phase and phase coherence cannot be evaluated or computed, so the construct stops operating. Operational dependency, not merely sayable. Law 8b removal test satisfied.

audio-dithering IS a DSP technique that adds noise before quantization to decorrelate quantization error. Its entire mechanism (noise shaping, amplitude control, bit-depth processing) requires signal-processing fundamentals. Remove signal-processing and audio dithering stops operating.

Phase response is a specific signal-processing concept describing the frequency-dependent phase shift introduced by a system, expressed as the argument (angle) of the complex frequency response H(jω). It is an instance of signal-processing — the discipline of algorithms and methods for analyzing and transforming signals. Sense pinned: phase response as the angular component of frequency response, not the colloquial sense of reacting to something.

Phase coherence is a signal-processing metric that requires DSP algorithms (DFT/STFT analysis, phase extraction, correlation computation) to measure. Remove signal processing and phase coherence has no mechanism for measurement or computation. This is a constitutive dependency.

Specific to general (Law 9): the Wiener filter is a filter in the target's pinned sense — its accepted definition's frequency-domain solution H(f) = S_x(f)/(S_x(f)+S_n(f)) is exactly a designed transfer function that selectively passes or attenuates frequency components (weighted by local SNR), matching the accepted def of 'filter' (selective pass/attenuation per designed transfer function). Nearest kind (Law 11e): no 'optimal-filter' or 'adaptive-filter' rung exists, and iir-filter is the wrong rung — the Wiener filter is defined by the MMSE criterion, not recursion; finite-length Wiener solutions are FIR. Servant-of relations (SERVES speech-enhancement) are a separate matter; this pins the kind-membership sense.
Formant vocoder is a specific implementation family within the broader vocoder technique class.
Mindfulness is a specific cognitive practice and attentional regulation technique. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

Gossip is built for the purpose of facilitating social communication — it circulates information, builds social bonds, and maintains group knowledge through informal channels. The servant (gossip) points at the master (communication). While it already has INSTANCE_OF→communication, SERVES adds the teleological dimension.

Deposition requires the legal framework to operate — a deposition is a sworn out-of-court testimony governed by procedural rules of law. Remove law and depositions lose their legal standing, procedural rules, and enforcement mechanism. They stop operating as legal instruments.

A pull request is an operational mechanism within version control systems — it requires the version control system (repository, branches, diffs) to function. Remove version control and a pull request cannot be created, merged, or reviewed. The which-came-first test: version-control predates pull-requests historically.

Merge conflicts exist for the sake of version control systems — they surface when parallel modifications need reconciliation. Version control is built to manage collaborative code changes, and merge conflicts are a feature designed to serve that purpose by alerting developers to resolution points.

Mel-cepstral-distortion operates on mel-frequency spectral representations of speech signals. Remove spectral-analysis (the decomposition of signals into frequency components) and the mel-cepstral coefficients cannot be extracted. The metric fundamentally depends on spectral analysis to produce its input data.

Formal law as an institution developed from the practice of articulating and resolving grievances. Which-came-first: grievance (0.11) predates law (0.29). The human practice of grievance — objecting to perceived wrongs — is the historical precursor to codified legal systems.

Griffin-Lim iterative phase reconstruction is built for the sake of recovering perceptually plausible audio waveforms from magnitude spectrograms, a core step in speech enhancement pipelines that need phase-aware reconstruction after mask-based magnitude enhancement. Servant points at master per Law 8d.
Rebase is a specific version-control operation that replays committed changes onto a new base. It IS a kind of version-control operation. Direction: specific→general. Law 9 satisfied.

A curse is a ritual act built for the sake of ritual practice — its designed purpose is to perform harm through ritual means. It serves the operation of ritual as a category of action. Servant→master.

anti-aliasing IS a DSP technique of filtering frequencies above Nyquist before sampling. Its mechanism (cutoff filtering, rolloff design) requires signal-processing fundamentals. Remove signal-processing and anti-aliasing stops operating.

Phase-locked vocoder was developed as a modification of the original phase vocoder to address phasiness artifacts by enforcing horizontal phase coherence. The original phase vocoder existed first and fed into the development of the phase-locked variant.

spectral-subtraction IS a DSP technique that operates on the frequency-domain representation of a signal -- it requires signal-processing fundamentals (FFT, windowing, spectral analysis) as its operational mechanism. Remove signal-processing methodology and spectral subtraction has no framework to operate.
Vocoder is a specific signal-processing technique family for analysis/resynthesis of audio; it is a particular kind of signal processing.
Pitch-synchronous is a vocoder technique that uses signal processing for frame-by-frame analysis and synthesis. Remove signal processing and pitch-synchronous vocoder methodology stops operating.

Pitch-detection algorithms fundamentally rely on speech processing methods — spectral analysis, filtering, and autocorrelation — to extract pitch from audio signals. Remove speech-processing and pitch-detection as a signal processing technique ceases to operate.

A grouped bar chart is a chart type that builds on the bar chart mechanism. It requires bars as its fundamental visual encoding element — grouped bar charts organize multiple bars per category using the bar-length encoding. Remove bar charts and grouped bar charts cease to function.

Cherry-picking is a specific type of cognitive bias where one selectively uses evidence that supports a conclusion while ignoring counterevidence. A competent speaker would call cherry-picking a cognitive bias.
Phase-locked vocoder is a specific variant of the vocoder family, preserving phase coherence across frames.
The concept of formants was developed through spectral analysis of speech signals. Speech processing existed first and fed into the formant concept.

Rumour requires the gossip mechanism to propagate — unverified claims spread through informal social gossip. Remove the gossip mechanism and rumour cannot operate or persist. The dependency is at the operational level: rumour is a content type that gossip is the transport for.

An index is built specifically to enable retrieval — its design purpose is to make it possible to find information by organizing entry points to content. For whose sake? Retrieval. The index points at retrieval as its master.

Merge conflict is a specific situation within version control where concurrent changes to the same content cannot be automatically reconciled. It is a concrete instance of a version-control event/problem.

Equity is a system of legal principles and remedies built for the sake of law — it exists to supplement formal law where rigid rules produce unjust outcomes. Its designed purpose is to further law's operation toward fairness. Servant→master: equity→law.

Dialectic is a specific form of reasoning that proceeds through dialogue, opposition, and synthesis of opposing viewpoints. A competent speaker would classify dialectic as 'a kind of reasoning' — it's the structured method of reasoning by thesis-antithesis-synthesis (or via sustained argument between positions).
A rumour is a specific kind of information: unverified claims or stories circulated informally between people. A competent speaker would call a rumour a form of information.

Rhetoric as a formal discipline of persuasive speaking/writing developed from the ancient practice of using tropes (figures of speech). Tropes existed as a practice long before rhetoric was codified as an art/form. Which-came-first test: trope (0.11) predates rhetoric (0.29).

A deposition is a specific kind of discovery: in adversarial litigation, discovery is the pretrial phase made up of the information-exchange devices — interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and depositions — and a deposition is one of those standard devices. A competent practitioner calls a deposition 'a discovery tool'; the Law 9 test (is X a specific kind of Y?) passes. Sense pinned per Law 11d: the deposition as the sworn out-of-court witness-examination device of civil and criminal procedure, not the transcript-as-evidence sense (that would relate to evidence, a different claim). Nearest kind: discovery, not law — filing against law would be a ladder leap.

Typology is a systematic classification scheme whose very mechanism is linguistic categorization. The types, their boundaries, and their relationships are defined through language. Remove language and typology cannot operate — classification requires categories named and related through linguistic structure. Object-level: the mechanism is language, not merely discussed via language.

Canonical references, standards, and authoritative forms serve retrieval — they provide trusted, indexed, and easily locatable information. A canonical entry in a knowledge base is designed to be found and relied upon. Servant→master per Law 8d.

Stare decisis (precedent) is a legal doctrine built for the sake of law — it exists to ensure consistency and predictability in legal outcomes. Its purpose is to further law's operation through reasoned continuity. Servant→master.

A new sustainability initiative or approach is a specific kind of sustainability effort — one that introduces novel methods or frameworks for sustainable practice. A competent speaker would call new-sustainability a type of sustainability.

User feedback is built for the purpose of driving iteration — it informs design improvements, feature refinements, and product cycles. The feedback loop exists to enable iteration. Servant→master per Law 8d.

A butterworth filter is an electronic filter whose operation depends on signal processing techniques — specifically, frequency-domain analysis and transfer function computation. Remove signal-processing (mathematical analysis and transformation of signals) and the filter cannot be designed or implemented: its cutoff characteristic, rolloff behavior, and passband flatness all require signal processing machinery to operate. This is not merely 'is a type of' — the butterworth filter's mechanism requires signal processing as a prerequisite.

Speech intelligibility measures how well speech is understood by human listeners — a perceptual metric grounded in how the auditory system processes sound. Remove psychoacoustics (the study of sound perception) and the concept of intelligibility as a perceptual measure collapses into mere acoustic clarity. The metric's meaning depends on psychoacoustic perception.

A prod-flip-witness is a specific type of record that documents and verifies the transition from the pre-flip to the post-flip Systema state. It is a kind of record — the nearest accepted kind. Sense pinned: prod-flip-witness as a record of system-state transition, not as a physical object or abstract concept.

Arbitration is a dispute-resolution mechanism built and maintained for the sake of law. Its designed purpose is to further legal resolution outside (or alongside) formal courts. The arrow points from servant (arbitration) to master (law).
Estoppel is a specific legal principle that prevents a party from asserting something contrary to a representation previously made. A competent speaker would call estoppel a legal principle.

Wiener filter is an optimal linear estimator built for the sake of noise reduction and signal estimation in speech processing pipelines. Its designed purpose is to further speech enhancement operation by minimizing mean-squared error. Servant points at master per Law 8d.
